page.layout: One printed page on the scan. Running head at top centre with page number 716 at left. Left margin holds short side notes (Celano, Fabrica, Capreola, Nepet). Main text in one column with indented inscriptions set as centred lines, numbered line markers at the right (10, 20, 30, 40, 50). Right margin note "Colonia", "Municipium, Incolae" in left margin beside second paragraph. Small catchword "Rempu" at lower right margin.

main_text.p: Celano, Fabrica, Capreola, Nepet.nt. Sunt eo tractu & alia Oppida, Celino, Fabrica, Capreola: mox Nepet Civitas. Sic Livio non uno loco, Paterculo lib. 1, Plinio lib. iii. cap. v, PriscIano, & aliis dicitur; quæ Νέπητ, Ptolemæo; Νέπη Straboni lib. v; Νέπητ Dionysio Halicarnassæo, ex cuius libro xiii Νέπητ Stephano laudatur. Varie etiam scribitur in Antiquis Monumentis: quorum unum ibi, in ipso Templo, in Urna cineraria:
main_text.l: M. APIITIVS. M. I. PAL. SABINVS. DVVMVIR

main_text.p: Colonia.Municipium, Incolæ.Nepensis Colonia, alias Nepis, Frontino; cui restituenda Nepet ex Paterculi Vol. 1. Hanc Coloniam etiam commemorat Livius lib. xxv & xxix. Festus Nepet Municipium suis Iuris tuisse refert. Incolæ Nepetes, Procopio lib. iii de Bello Gothico; Nepesini in Bath, quæ in Foro Civitatis Nepesinorum erecta visitur:
Leguntur & in alia ibidem Bath, ex qua duo superiores Versus sunt erosi. Sic Municipes Nepesini in alio Lapide nominantur:

page.notes: Scan is a skewed photograph; the inscriptions are printed in a stylised lapidary typeface with ornaments (leaves, fleurons) shown as ✠-like marks, rendered here as plain spaces or letters. Several Greek words in the margin and text are approximate: Greek is printed but illegible in places. Line-number markers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 stand at right. Lines of the second inscription "STRATI VERVA" and "RIO. MILITES" are uncertain. Marginal note "Rempu" is a catchword and is partly cut off.
